reasons.claim: Notification is a 2.65 ha polygon (Föryngringsavverkning, Rättvik) with status 'Anmält för avverkning'.

No species records inside or within 250 m, and no eligible species were reported in any ring per the rubric hint.

Recording effort is low: 8 records and 2 observation days within 1000 m versus a county median of 66 (14th percentile); 0 records inside or within 250 m (county median within 250 m is 3). Lack of records is therefore weak evidence.

uncertainties: Whether any threatened or other species occur on the site is unknown because the area is little surveyed.
The county reference sample is of 50 notifications and may not represent this site.
not_established: Absence of records does not mean absence of species.
Nothing here establishes the forest's ecological value or that the site is safe to fell.
Hidden or coordinate-obscured sensitive species would not appear in public data.
next_action: Treat as a survey gap: consider a field inventory or a check of local knowledge before felling can begin (normally at least six weeks after notification, which was 2026-10-02).
